title: Official Ravensburger card catalog in rules-data, real-card stories, the card tile (D25, D26) and Storybook 10.6.2
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: packages/rules-data activated as a browser-safe ('public') workspace under ADR 0018: observed Ravensburger v3 record types and validators (strict on the 15 always-present fields and typed optional ones, keeping unknown fields, rejecting unreviewed categories); a normalized catalog keeping printings (culture_invariant_id) apart from the card in play (deck_building_id), with variants, finishes (an Enchanted or promo Regular variant can be foil) and CardFX foil layers; unreviewed inks and rarities throw.

Rules-text display tokens: \Name\ abilities, <Keyword> keywords, {X} symbols (I ink, E exert, S strength, W willpower, L lore, C inkwell, the last confirmed on Madam Mim – Hummingbird's printed card) and parenthesized reminder text, keeping every printed character with an exact round trip. Older records' % breaks normalize to the line and paragraph breaks current records write. A reviewed correction ledger (src/corrections.ts) fixes nine records whose ability delimiter was lost, markup only, with evidence from the other languages; the full audit fails when a correction stops matching.

Node-only tooling in packages/rules-data/scripts: bounded sequential HTTPS acquisition (no redirects, 60 s, 40 MB) into the ignored content-addressed .local/catalog/ravensburger cache with an exclusively created dated record under docs/rules; a fixture builder copying 12 selected records exactly and storing 24 images byte for byte with source URL, retrieval time, SHA-256, dimensions, rendition and the D07 rights basis; and catalog:verify, which audits every acquired language in full and reproduces the fixture from the recorded snapshot.

RUN-20261021-012 acquired English, German, French and Italian (3,558 / 3,557 / 3,557 / 3,557 cards, app version 2026.5) with full validation and normalization; Spanish answered 403. Package tests use only real records: normalization of printed values, invalid records made by breaking one field of a real record, token sequences and round trips, the correction ledger, image checksums and dimensions, and acquisition against a local server serving a catalog assembled from the fixture records.

Design system (decision D26): CardTile shows the card itself as one React Aria button named 'Inspect <name> – <version>, <set> <number>' (reprints stay distinguishable, the card name comes first per WCAG 2.5.3); the text under the image and the ownership and actions props are removed; foil printings keep a static Foil mark (§16); the card silhouette is the physical corner; hover and press change the outline only. CardImage follows the takedown switch (officialAssets={false}) and is decorative inside the tile. A new finish.foilMark message.

Stories and browser tests (decision D25): every card, set and ability now comes from @lorcana/rules-data/fixtures (a development dependency of the design system; components still take only the presentational Printing type); Storybook serves the fixture images at /catalog-images. Replaced: Synthetic Explorer and friends, invented sets and abilities, the neutral fixture art; deck names lose their 'Synthetic' prefix. The current inspector stories render printed symbols as words until the D24 redesign.

Design-system browser suite 163 tests (new: tile identity and printing names, foil mark, real image loading, hover stability, takedown placeholder, image failure; the ownership check moves to the inspector). A visual check of the tile grid, the inspector opened from a tile, the card faces and the inspector in Paper and Ink was captured and reviewed (not committed).

GHSA-f2ph-cmg5-wxc8 (critical: Storybook preview lacks origin validation, allowing code injection from malicious websites) was published 2026-10-21 17:23Z against 10.0.0–10.6.1 and failed this change's first full check (RUN-20261021-013, pnpm audit). storybook and @storybook/react-vite move to 10.6.2, the first fixed release (2026-10-12); only the five Storybook packages change in the lockfile. Main would fail the same audit on its next run.
ESLint: a scoped globals entry for packages/rules-data scripts and tests (AbortSignal, structuredClone), following the existing per-file pattern.
CHG-20261021-004 appended its status line to AGENTS.md and docs/README.md but not to the root README.md, which carries the same paragraph; the root README now has both that line and this change's.
